QuestInfo.name: What's the Deal with Kaiser?
QuestInfo.0: You haven't seen Kaiser lately. #b#p3001100##k probably knows where he is!
QuestInfo.1: You are told that Kaiser has been sent to #p3001002# to obtain information on the two castle guardians. #b#p3001101##k is looking for you. Is #p3001100# trying to separate you and Kaiser on purpose?
QuestInfo.2: Kaiser went with #p3001002# to obtain information on the two castle guardians. You better start a mission of your own then.

0.0: We must focus on capturing the area. I sent Kaiser to find #p3001002# and gather some intel on the castle interiors.
0.1: In the meantime, #b#p3001101##k is looking for you.

yes.0: Don't tell me you don't know where to find #p3001101#.

no.0: Recapturing and stabilizing this region is the utmost priority.

yes.0: You did good out there with the trap. I didn't expect your dainty little feet to be kicking so much rear-end. Follow my orders and we'll have this place under control in no time.

npc.0: You came back here because you couldn't find #p3001101#? That is ridiculous. LEARN TO USE A MAP.
